title: NoticeCheck facts (schema 0.1)
description: Facts of the GST demand proceeding as stated in the judgment. Never guess: if the judgment does not state a value, set value, quote and para to null.

provision.description: Section of the CGST/SGST Act under which the demand proceeding was started

quote.description: exact words from the judgment that state this value; null if value is null

para.description: the judgment's paragraph number containing the quote

financial_years.description: Financial years covered, e.g. ["2018-19"]; more than one means a consolidated notice

quote.description: exact words from the judgment that state this value; null if value is null

para.description: the judgment's paragraph number containing the quote

notices.description: Each show cause notice (Form DRC-01) in this proceeding, usually one. Empty if the judgment gives no notice details.

date.description: Date the show cause notice was issued

quote.description: exact words from the judgment that state this value; null if value is null

para.description: the judgment's paragraph number containing the quote

reply_due.description: Last date for the reply stated in the notice

quote.description: exact words from the judgment that state this value; null if value is null

para.description: the judgment's paragraph number containing the quote

hearing_date_given.description: false if the notice gave no hearing date, or wrote NA, or no hearing date was fixed; true if a date was given

quote.description: exact words from the judgment that state this value; null if value is null

para.description: the judgment's paragraph number containing the quote

hearing_date.description: Personal hearing date fixed in the notice

quote.description: exact words from the judgment that state this value; null if value is null

para.description: the judgment's paragraph number containing the quote

service_mode.description: How the notice reached the taxpayer. portal_additional_notices_tab / portal_notices_tab: only if the judgment names that tab ('Additional Notices' or 'Notices and Orders'); portal_unspecified: uploaded on the GST portal, tab not named; not_served: the judgment says it was never served.

quote.description: exact words from the judgment that state this value; null if value is null

para.description: the judgment's paragraph number containing the quote

signed.description: Whether the notice was signed or authenticated

quote.description: exact words from the judgment that state this value; null if value is null

para.description: the judgment's paragraph number containing the quote

summary_only.description: true if only the DRC-01 summary was issued without a detailed notice

quote.description: exact words from the judgment that state this value; null if value is null

para.description: the judgment's paragraph number containing the quote

order.description: The demand order under s.73(9)/74(9) being challenged (DRC-07 or the adjudication order it summarises). If both are mentioned with different dates, use the adjudication order and add the other as an order_passed event.

quote.description: exact words from the judgment that state this value; null if value is null

para.description: the judgment's paragraph number containing the quote

signed.description: Whether the order was signed or authenticated

quote.description: exact words from the judgment that state this value; null if value is null

para.description: the judgment's paragraph number containing the quote

service_mode.description: How the order reached the taxpayer. portal_additional_notices_tab / portal_notices_tab: only if the judgment names that tab ('Additional Notices' or 'Notices and Orders'); portal_unspecified: uploaded on the GST portal, tab not named; not_served: the judgment says it was never served.

quote.description: exact words from the judgment that state this value; null if value is null

para.description: the judgment's paragraph number containing the quote

events.description: Steps in the proceeding, in date order. date = the day that step happened (a request: the day it was made; hearing_adjourned: the hearing day that was put off, with the new date as a separate hearing_scheduled event). Use reply_not_filed or hearing_missed only when the judgment says so; a missing event means 'not stated', not 'did not happen'.

document_contents.description: What the notice, the reply and the order SAID, as the judgment reports it (only what bears on a defect). Describe the document, never the court's opinion of it: 'the order states no evidence of RCM payment was produced' is allowed; 'the order is cursory' is not. Empty if the judgment does not report the contents.

type.description: scn_ground: what the notice alleges or demands. fraud_allegation: the notice's allegation of fraud, wilful misstatement or suppression (s.74). reply_point: an argument the taxpayer made in the reply. order_reasoning: what the order says when deciding.
